translations.ylt: What, then, is my reward? --that proclaiming good news, without charge I shall make the good news of the Christ, not to abuse my authority in the good news;
translations.web: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

translations.kjv: For though I be free from all men, yet have I made myself servant unto all, that I might gain the more.
translations.ylt: for being free from all men, to all men I made myself servant, that the more I might gain;
translations.web: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

translations.kjv: And unto the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain the Jews; to them that are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain them that are under the law;
translations.ylt: and I became to the Jews as a Jew, that Jews I might gain; to those under law as under law, that those under law I might gain;
translations.web: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

translations.kjv: To them that are without law, as without law, (being not without law to God, but under the law to Christ,) that I might gain them that are without law.
translations.ylt: to those without law, as without law--(not being without law to God, but within law to Christ) --that I might gain those without law;
translations.web: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

translations.kjv: To the weak became I as weak, that I might gain the weak: I am made all things to all men, that I might by all means save some.
translations.ylt: I became to the infirm as infirm, that the infirm I might gain; to all men I have become all things, that by all means I may save some.
translations.web: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

translations.kjv: And this I do for the gospel’s sake, that I might be partaker thereof with you.
translations.ylt: And this I do because of the good news, that a fellow-partaker of it I may become;
translations.web: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

translations.kjv: Know ye not that they which run in a race run all, but one receiveth the prize? So run, that ye may obtain.
translations.ylt: have ye not known that those running in a race--all indeed run, but one doth receive the prize? so run ye, that ye may obtain;
translations.web: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

translations.kjv: And every man that striveth for the mastery is temperate in all things. Now they do it to obtain a corruptible crown; but we an incorruptible.
translations.ylt: and every one who is striving, is in all things temperate; these, indeed, then, that a corruptible crown they may receive, but we an incorruptible;
translations.web: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

translations.kjv: I therefore so run, not as uncertainly; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
translations.ylt: I, therefore, thus run, not as uncertainly, thus I fight, as not beating air;
translations.web: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

translations.kjv: But I keep under my body, and bring it into subjection: lest that by any means, when I have preached to others, I myself should be a castaway.
translations.ylt: but I chastise my body, and bring it into servitude, lest by any means, having preached to others--I myself may become disapproved.
translations.web: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

translations.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I would not that ye should be ignorant, how that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;
translations.ylt: And I do not wish you to be ignorant, brethren, that all our fathers were under the cloud, and all passed through the sea,
translations.web: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

translations.kjv: And were all baptized unto Moses in the cloud and in the sea;
translations.ylt: and all to Moses were baptized in the cloud, and in the sea;
translations.web: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

translations.kjv: And did all eat the same spiritual meat;
translations.ylt: and all the same spiritual food did eat,
translations.web: and all ate the same spiritual food;

translations.kjv: And did all drink the same spiritual drink: for they drank of that spiritual Rock that followed them: and that Rock was Christ.
translations.ylt: and all the same spiritual drink did drink, for they were drinking of a spiritual rock following them, and the rock was the Christ;
translations.web: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

translations.kjv: But with many of them God was not well pleased: for they were overthrown in the wilderness.
translations.ylt: but in the most of them God was not well pleased, for they were strewn in the wilderness,
translations.web: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

translations.kjv: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.
translations.ylt: and those things became types of us, for our not passionately desiring evil things, as also these did desire.
translations.web: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

translations.kjv: Neither be ye idolaters, as were some of them; as it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.
translations.ylt: Neither become ye idolaters, as certain of them, as it hath been written, `The people sat down to eat and to drink, and stood up to play;'
translations.web: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

translations.kjv: Neither let us commit fornication, as some of them committed, and fell in one day three and twenty thousand.
translations.ylt: neither may we commit whoredom, as certain of them did commit whoredom, and there fell in one day twenty-three thousand;
translations.web: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

translations.kjv: Neither let us tempt Christ, as some of them also tempted, and were destroyed of serpents.
translations.ylt: neither may we tempt the Christ, as also certain of them did tempt, and by the serpents did perish;
translations.web: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

translations.kjv: Neither murmur ye, as some of them also murmured, and were destroyed of the destroyer.
translations.ylt: neither murmur ye, as also some of them did murmur, and did perish by the destroyer.
translations.web: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

translations.kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
translations.ylt: And all these things as types did happen to those persons, and they were written for our admonition, to whom the end of the ages did come,
translations.web: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

translations.kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
translations.ylt: so that he who is thinking to stand--let him observe, lest he fall.
translations.web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

translations.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
translations.ylt: No temptation hath taken you--except human; and God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above what ye are able, but He will make, with the temptation, also the outlet, for your being able to bear it.
translations.web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
translations.ylt: Wherefore, my beloved, flee from the idolatry;
translations.web: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

translations.kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
translations.ylt: as to wise men I speak--judge ye what I say:
translations.web: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

translations.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
translations.ylt: The cup of the blessing that we bless--is it not the fellowship of the blood of the Christ? the bread that we break--is it not the fellowship of the body of the Christ?
translations.web: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

translations.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
translations.ylt: because one bread, one body, are we the many--for we all of the one bread do partake.
translations.web: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

translations.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
translations.ylt: See Israel according to the flesh! are not those eating the sacrifices in the fellowship of the altar?
translations.web: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

translations.kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
translations.ylt: what then do I say? that an idol is anything? or that a sacrifice offered to an idol is anything? --
translations.web: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

translations.kjv: But I say, that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
translations.ylt: no, but that the things that the nations sacrifice--they sacrifice to demons and not to God; and I do not wish you to come into the fellowship of the demons.
translations.web: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

translations.kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
translations.ylt: Ye are not able the cup of the Lord to drink, and the cup of demons; ye are not able of the table of the Lord to partake, and of the table of demons;
translations.web: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

translations.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
translations.ylt: do we arouse the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than He?
translations.web: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

translations.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
translations.ylt: All things to me are lawful, but all things are not profitable; all things to me are lawful, but all things do not build up;
translations.web: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

translations.kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth.
translations.ylt: let no one seek his own--but each another's.
translations.web: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

translations.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
translations.ylt: Whatever in the meat-market is sold eat ye, not inquiring, because of the conscience,
translations.web: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

translations.kjv: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
translations.ylt: for the Lord's is the earth, and its fulness;
translations.web: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

translations.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast, and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
translations.ylt: and if any one of the unbelieving do call you, and ye wish to go, all that is set before you eat, nothing inquiring, because of the conscience;
translations.web: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

translations.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:
translations.ylt: and if any one may say to you, `This is a thing sacrificed to an idol,' --do not eat, because of that one who shewed it, and of the conscience, for the Lord's is the earth and its fulness:
translations.web: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

translations.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
translations.ylt: and conscience, I say, not of thyself, but of the other, for why is it that my liberty is judged by another's conscience?
translations.web: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

translations.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
translations.ylt: and if I thankfully do partake, why am I evil spoken of, for that for which I give thanks?
translations.web: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

translations.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
translations.ylt: Whether, then, ye eat, or drink, or do anything, do all to the glory of God;
translations.web: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

translations.kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
translations.ylt: become offenceless, both to Jews and Greeks, and to the assembly of God;
translations.web: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

translations.kjv: Even as I please all men in all things, not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
translations.ylt: as I also in all things do please all, not seeking my own profit, but that of many--that they may be saved.
translations.web: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

translations.kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
translations.ylt: Followers of me become ye, as I also am of Christ.
translations.web: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

translations.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
translations.ylt: And I praise you, brethren, that in all things ye remember me, and according as I did deliver to you, the deliverances ye keep,
translations.web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

translations.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
translations.ylt: and I wish you to know that of every man the head is the Christ, and the head of a woman is the husband, and the head of Christ is God.
translations.web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

translations.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
translations.ylt: Every man praying or prophesying, having the head covered, doth dishonour his head,
translations.web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

translations.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
translations.ylt: and every woman praying or prophesying with the head uncovered, doth dishonour her own head, for it is one and the same thing with her being shaven,
translations.web: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

translations.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
translations.ylt: for if a woman is not covered--then let her be shorn, and if it is a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven--let her be covered;
translations.web: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

translations.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
translations.ylt: for a man, indeed, ought not to cover the head, being the image and glory of God, and a woman is the glory of a man,
translations.web: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

translations.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
translations.ylt: for a man is not of a woman, but a woman is of a man,
translations.web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

translations.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
translations.ylt: for a man also was not created because of the woman, but a woman because of the man;
translations.web: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

translations.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
translations.ylt: because of this the woman ought to have a token of authority upon the head, because of the messengers;
translations.web: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

translations.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
translations.ylt: but neither is a man apart from a woman, nor a woman apart from a man, in the Lord,
translations.web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

translations.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
translations.ylt: for as the woman is of the man, so also the man is through the woman, and the all things are of God.
translations.web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

translations.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
translations.ylt: In your own selves judge ye; is it seemly for a woman uncovered to pray to God?
translations.web: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

translations.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
translations.ylt: doth not even nature itself teach you, that if a man indeed have long hair, a dishonour it is to him?
translations.web: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

translations.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
translations.ylt: and a woman, if she have long hair, a glory it is to her, because the hair instead of a covering hath been given to her;
translations.web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

translations.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
translations.ylt: and if any one doth think to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the assemblies of God.
translations.web: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

translations.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
translations.ylt: And this declaring, I give no praise, because not for the better, but for the worse ye come together;
translations.web: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

translations.kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
translations.ylt: for first, indeed, ye coming together in an assembly, I hear of divisions being among you, and partly I believe it,
translations.web: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

translations.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
translations.ylt: for it behoveth sects also to be among you, that those approved may become manifest among you;
translations.web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

translations.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
translations.ylt: ye, then, coming together at the same place--it is not to eat the Lord's supper;
translations.web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

translations.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
translations.ylt: for each his own supper doth take before in the eating, and one is hungry, and another is drunk;
translations.web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

translations.kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
translations.ylt: why, have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or the assembly of God do ye despise, and shame those not having? what may I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I do not praise!
translations.web: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

translations.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
translations.ylt: For I--I received from the Lord that which also I did deliver to you, that the Lord Jesus in the night in which he was delivered up, took bread,
translations.web: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

translations.kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it, and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
translations.ylt: and having given thanks, he brake, and said, `Take ye, eat ye, this is my body, that for you is being broken; this do ye--to the remembrance of me.'
translations.web: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

translations.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it, in remembrance of me.
translations.ylt: In like manner also the cup after the supping, saying, `This cup is the new covenant in my blood; this do ye, as often as ye may drink it --to the remembrance of me;'
translations.web: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

translations.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
translations.ylt: for as often as ye may eat this bread, and this cup may drink, the death of the Lord ye do shew forth--till he may come;
translations.web: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

translations.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
translations.ylt: so that whoever may eat this bread or may drink the cup of the Lord unworthily, guilty he shall be of the body and blood of the Lord:
translations.web: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

translations.kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
translations.ylt: and let a man be proving himself, and so of the bread let him eat, and of the cup let him drink;
translations.web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

translations.kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
translations.ylt: for he who is eating and drinking unworthily, judgment to himself he doth eat and drink--not discerning the body of the Lord.
translations.web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

translations.kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
translations.ylt: Because of this, among you many are weak and sickly, and sleep do many;
translations.web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

translations.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
translations.ylt: for if ourselves we were discerning, we would not be being judged,
translations.web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

translations.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
translations.ylt: and being judged by the Lord, we are chastened, that with the world we may not be condemned;
translations.web: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
translations.ylt: so then, my brethren, coming together to eat, for one another wait ye;
translations.web: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

translations.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
translations.ylt: and if any one is hungry, at home let him eat, that to judgment ye may not come together; and the rest, whenever I may come, I shall arrange.
translations.web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

translations.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
translations.ylt: And concerning the spiritual things, brethren, I do not wish you to be ignorant;
translations.web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

translations.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
translations.ylt: ye have known that ye were nations, unto the dumb idols--as ye were led--being carried away;
translations.web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

translations.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
translations.ylt: wherefore, I give you to understand that no one, in the Spirit of God speaking, saith Jesus is anathema, and no one is able to say Jesus is Lord, except in the Holy Spirit.
translations.web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

translations.kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
translations.ylt: And there are diversities of gifts, and the same Spirit;
translations.web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

translations.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
translations.ylt: and there are diversities of ministrations, and the same Lord;
translations.web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

translations.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
translations.ylt: and there are diversities of workings, and it is the same God--who is working the all in all.
translations.web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

translations.kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
translations.ylt: And to each hath been given the manifestation of the Spirit for profit;
translations.web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

translations.kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
translations.ylt: for to one through the Spirit hath been given a word of wisdom, and to another a word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;
translations.web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

translations.kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
translations.ylt: and to another faith in the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings in the same Spirit;
translations.web: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

translations.kjv: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
translations.ylt: and to another in-workings of mighty deeds; and to another prophecy; and to another discernings of spirits; and to another divers kinds of tongues; and to another interpretation of tongues:
translations.web: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

translations.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
translations.ylt: and all these doth work the one and the same Spirit, dividing to each severally as he intendeth.
translations.web: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

translations.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
translations.ylt: For, even as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of the one body, being many, are one body, so also is the Christ,
translations.web: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

translations.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
translations.ylt: for also in one Spirit we all to one body were baptized, whether Jews or Greeks, whether servants or freemen, and all into one Spirit were made to drink,
translations.web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

translations.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.
translations.ylt: for also the body is not one member, but many;
translations.web: For the body is not one member, but many.

translations.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
translations.ylt: if the foot may say, `Because I am not a hand, I am not of the body;' it is not, because of this, not of the body;
translations.web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

translations.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
translations.ylt: and if the ear may say, `Because I am not an eye, I am not of the body;' it is not, because of this, not of the body?
translations.web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

translations.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
translations.ylt: If the whole body were an eye, where the hearing? if the whole hearing, where the smelling?
translations.web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

translations.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
translations.ylt: and now, God did set the members each one of them in the body, according as He willed,
translations.web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

translations.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
translations.ylt: and if all were one member, where the body?
translations.web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

translations.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
translations.ylt: and now, indeed, are many members, and one body;
translations.web: But now they are many members, but one body.

translations.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
translations.ylt: and an eye is not able to say to the hand, `I have no need of thee;' nor again the head to the feet, `I have no need of you.'
translations.web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

translations.kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
translations.ylt: But much more the members of the body which seem to be more infirm are necessary,
translations.web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

translations.kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
translations.ylt: and those that we think to be less honourable of the body, around these we put more abundant honour, and our unseemly things have seemliness more abundant,
translations.web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

translations.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
translations.ylt: and our seemly things have no need; but God did temper the body together, to the lacking part having given more abundant honour,
translations.web: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

translations.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
translations.ylt: that there may be no division in the body, but that the members may have the same anxiety for one another,
translations.web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

translations.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
translations.ylt: and whether one member doth suffer, suffer with it do all the members, or one member is glorified, rejoice with it do all the members;
translations.web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

translations.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
translations.ylt: and ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
translations.web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

translations.kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
translations.ylt: And some, indeed, did God set in the assembly, first apostles, secondly prophets, thirdly teachers, afterwards powers, afterwards gifts of healings, helpings, governings, divers kinds of tongues;
translations.web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

translations.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
translations.ylt: are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all powers?
translations.web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

translations.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
translations.ylt: have all gifts of healings? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
translations.web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

translations.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
translations.ylt: and desire earnestly the better gifts; and yet a far excelling way do I shew to you:
translations.web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

translations.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
translations.ylt: If with the tongues of men and of messengers I speak, and have not love, I have become brass sounding, or a cymbal tinkling;
translations.web: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

translations.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
translations.ylt: and if I have prophecy, and know all the secrets, and all the knowledge, and if I have all the faith, so as to remove mountains, and have not love, I am nothing;
translations.web: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

translations.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
translations.ylt: and if I give away to feed others all my goods, and if I give up my body that I may be burned, and have not love, I am profited nothing.
translations.web: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

translations.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
translations.ylt: The love is long-suffering, it is kind, the love doth not envy, the love doth not vaunt itself, is not puffed up,
translations.web: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

translations.kjv: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
translations.ylt: doth not act unseemly, doth not seek its own things, is not provoked, doth not impute evil,
translations.web: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

translations.kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
translations.ylt: rejoiceth not over the unrighteousness, and rejoiceth with the truth;
translations.web: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

translations.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
translations.ylt: all things it beareth, all it believeth, all it hopeth, all it endureth.
translations.web: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

translations.kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
translations.ylt: The love doth never fail; and whether there be prophecies, they shall become useless; whether tongues, they shall cease; whether knowledge, it shall become useless;
translations.web: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

translations.kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
translations.ylt: for in part we know, and in part we prophecy;
translations.web: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

translations.kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
translations.ylt: and when that which is perfect may come, then that which is in part shall become useless.
translations.web: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

translations.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
translations.ylt: When I was a babe, as a babe I was speaking, as a babe I was thinking, as a babe I was reasoning, and when I have become a man, I have made useless the things of the babe;
translations.web: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

translations.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
translations.ylt: for we see now through a mirror obscurely, and then face to face; now I know in part, and then I shall fully know, as also I was known;
translations.web: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

translations.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
translations.ylt: and now there doth remain faith, hope, love--these three; and the greatest of these is love.
translations.web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

translations.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts, but rather that ye may prophesy.
translations.ylt: Pursue the love, and seek earnestly the spiritual things, and rather that ye may prophecy,
translations.web: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

translations.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
translations.ylt: for he who is speaking in an unknown tongue--to men he doth not speak, but to God, for no one doth hearken, and in spirit he doth speak secrets;
translations.web: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

translations.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
translations.ylt: and he who is prophesying to men doth speak edification, and exhortation, and comfort;
translations.web: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

translations.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
translations.ylt: he who is speaking in an unknown tongue, himself doth edify, and he who is prophesying, an assembly doth edify;
translations.web: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

translations.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
translations.ylt: and I wish you all to speak with tongues, and more that ye may prophecy, for greater is he who is prophesying than he who is speaking with tongues, except one may interpret, that the assembly may receive edification.
translations.web: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

translations.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
translations.ylt: And now, brethren, if I may come unto you speaking tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either in revelation, or in knowledge, or in prophesying, or in teaching?
translations.web: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

translations.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
translations.ylt: yet the things without life giving sound--whether pipe or harp--if a difference in the sounds they may not give, how shall be known that which is piped or that which is harped?
translations.web: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

translations.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
translations.ylt: for if also an uncertain sound a trumpet may give, who shall prepare himself for battle?
translations.web: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

translations.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
translations.ylt: so also ye, if through the tongue, speech easily understood ye may not give--how shall that which is spoken be known? for ye shall be speaking to air.
translations.web: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

translations.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
translations.ylt: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is unmeaning,
translations.web: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

translations.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
translations.ylt: if, then, I do not know the power of the voice, I shall be to him who is speaking a foreigner, and he who is speaking, is to me a foreigner;
translations.web: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

translations.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts, seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
translations.ylt: so also ye, since ye are earnestly desirous of spiritual gifts, for the building up of the assembly seek that ye may abound;
translations.web: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

translations.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
translations.ylt: wherefore he who is speaking in an unknown tongue--let him pray that he may interpret;
translations.web: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

translations.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
translations.ylt: for if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit doth pray, and my understanding is unfruitful.
translations.web: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

translations.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
translations.ylt: What then is it? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray also with the understanding; I will sing psalms with the spirit, and I will sing psalms also with the understanding;
translations.web: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

translations.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
translations.ylt: since, if thou mayest bless with the spirit, he who is filling the place of the unlearned, how shall he say the Amen at thy giving of thanks, since what thou dost say he hath not known?
translations.web: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

translations.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
translations.ylt: for thou, indeed, dost give thanks well, but the other is not built up!
translations.web: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

translations.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
translations.ylt: I give thanks to my God--more than you all with tongues speaking--
translations.web: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

translations.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
translations.ylt: but in an assembly I wish to speak five words through my understanding, that others also I may instruct, rather than myriads of words in an unknown tongue.
translations.web: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

translations.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
translations.ylt: Brethren, become not children in the understanding, but in the evil be ye babes, and in the understanding become ye perfect;
translations.web: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

translations.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
translations.ylt: in the law it hath been written, that, `With other tongues and with other lips I will speak to this people, and not even so will they hear Me, saith the Lord;'
translations.web: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

translations.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
translations.ylt: so that the tongues are for a sign, not to the believing, but to the unbelieving; and the prophesy is not for the unbelieving, but for the believing,
translations.web: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

translations.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
translations.ylt: If, therefore, the whole assembly may come together, to the same place, and all may speak with tongues, and there may come in unlearned or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
translations.web: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

translations.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
translations.ylt: and if all may prophecy, and any one may come in, an unbeliever or unlearned, he is convicted by all, he is discerned by all,
translations.web: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

translations.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
translations.ylt: and so the secrets of his heart become manifest, and so having fallen upon his face, he will bow before God, declaring that God really is among you.
translations.web: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

translations.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
translations.ylt: What then is it, brethren? whenever ye may come together, each of you hath a psalm, hath a teaching, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation? let all things be for building up;
translations.web: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

translations.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
translations.ylt: if an unknown tongue any one do speak, by two, or at the most, by three, and in turn, and let one interpret;
translations.web: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

translations.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
translations.ylt: and if there may be no interpreter, let him be silent in an assembly, and to himself let him speak, and to God.
translations.web: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

translations.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
translations.ylt: And prophets--let two or three speak, and let the others discern,
translations.web: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

translations.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
translations.ylt: and if to another sitting anything may be revealed, let the first be silent;
translations.web: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

translations.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
translations.ylt: for ye are able, one by one, all to prophesy, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted,
translations.web: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

translations.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
translations.ylt: and the spiritual gift of prophets to prophets are subject,
translations.web: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

translations.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
translations.ylt: for God is not a God of tumult, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
translations.web: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

translations.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
translations.ylt: Your women in the assemblies let them be silent, for it hath not been permitted to them to speak, but to be subject, as also the law saith;
translations.web: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

translations.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
translations.ylt: and if they wish to learn anything, at home their own husbands let them question, for it is a shame to women to speak in an assembly.
translations.web: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

translations.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
translations.ylt: From you did the word of God come forth? or to you alone did it come?
translations.web: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

translations.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
translations.ylt: if any one doth think to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge the things that I write to you--that of the Lord they are commands;
translations.web: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

translations.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
translations.ylt: and if any one is ignorant--let him be ignorant;
translations.web: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

translations.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
translations.ylt: so that, brethren, earnestly desire to prophesy, and to speak with tongues do not forbid;
translations.web: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

translations.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
translations.ylt: let all things be done decently and in order.
translations.web: Let all things be done decently and in order.

translations.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
translations.ylt: And I make known to you, brethren, the good news that I proclaimed to you, which also ye did receive, in which also ye have stood,
translations.web: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

translations.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
translations.ylt: through which also ye are being saved, in what words I proclaimed good news to you, if ye hold fast, except ye did believe in vain,
translations.web: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

translations.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
translations.ylt: for I delivered to you first, what also I did receive, that Christ died for our sins, according to the Writings,
translations.web: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

translations.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
translations.ylt: and that he was buried, and that he hath risen on the third day, according to the Writings,
translations.web: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

translations.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
translations.ylt: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve,
translations.web: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

translations.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
translations.ylt: afterwards he appeared to above five hundred brethren at once, of whom the greater part remain till now, and certain also did fall asleep;
translations.web: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

translations.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
translations.ylt: afterwards he appeared to James, then to all the apostles.
translations.web: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

translations.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
translations.ylt: And last of all--as to the untimely birth--he appeared also to me,
translations.web: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

translations.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
translations.ylt: for I am the least of the apostles, who am not worthy to be called an apostle, because I did persecute the assembly of God,
translations.web: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

translations.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
translations.ylt: and by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace that is towards me came not in vain, but more abundantly than they all did I labour, yet not I, but the grace of God that is with me;
translations.web: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

translations.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
translations.ylt: whether, then, I or they, so we preach, and so ye did believe.
translations.web: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

translations.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
translations.ylt: And if Christ is preached, that out of the dead he hath risen, how say certain among you, that there is no rising again of dead persons?
translations.web: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

translations.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
translations.ylt: and if there be no rising again of dead persons, neither hath Christ risen;
translations.web: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

translations.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
translations.ylt: and if Christ hath not risen, then void is our preaching, and void also your faith,
translations.web: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

translations.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
translations.ylt: and we also are found false witnesses of God, because we did testify of God that He raised up the Christ, whom He did not raise if then dead persons do not rise;
translations.web: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

translations.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
translations.ylt: for if dead persons do not rise, neither hath Christ risen,
translations.web: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

translations.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
translations.ylt: and if Christ hath not risen, vain is your faith, ye are yet in your sins;
translations.web: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

translations.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
translations.ylt: then, also, those having fallen asleep in Christ did perish;
translations.web: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

translations.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
translations.ylt: if in this life we have hope in Christ only, of all men we are most to be pitied.
translations.web: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

translations.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
translations.ylt: And now, Christ hath risen out of the dead--the first-fruits of those sleeping he became,
translations.web: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

translations.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
translations.ylt: for since through man is the death, also through man is a rising again of the dead,
translations.web: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

translations.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
translations.ylt: for even as in Adam all die, so also in the Christ all shall be made alive,
translations.web: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

translations.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
translations.ylt: and each in his proper order, a first-fruit Christ, afterwards those who are the Christ's, in his presence,
translations.web: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

translations.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
translations.ylt: then--the end, when he may deliver up the reign to God, even the Father, when he may have made useless all rule, and all authority and power--
translations.web: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

translations.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
translations.ylt: for it behoveth him to reign till he may have put all the enemies under his feet--
translations.web: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

translations.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
translations.ylt: the last enemy is done away--death;
translations.web: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

translations.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
translations.ylt: for all things He did put under his feet, and, when one may say that all things have been subjected, it is evident that He is excepted who did subject the all things to him,
translations.web: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

translations.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
translations.ylt: and when the all things may be subjected to him, then the Son also himself shall be subject to Him, who did subject to him the all things, that God may be the all in all.
translations.web: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

translations.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
translations.ylt: Seeing what shall they do who are baptized for the dead, if the dead do not rise at all? why also are they baptized for the dead?
translations.web: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

translations.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
translations.ylt: why also do we stand in peril every hour?
translations.web: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

translations.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
translations.ylt: Every day do I die, by the glorying of you that I have in Christ Jesus our Lord:
translations.web: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

translations.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
translations.ylt: if after the manner of a man with wild beasts I fought in Ephesus, what the advantage to me if the dead do not rise? let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we die!
translations.web: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

translations.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
translations.ylt: Be not led astray; evil communications corrupt good manners;
translations.web: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

translations.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
translations.ylt: awake up, as is right, and sin not; for certain have an ignorance of God; for shame to you I say it.
translations.web: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

translations.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
translations.ylt: But some one will say, `How do the dead rise?
translations.web: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

translations.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
translations.ylt: unwise! thou--what thou dost sow is not quickened except it may die;
translations.web: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

translations.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:
translations.ylt: and that which thou dost sow, not the body that shall be dost thou sow, but bare grain, it may be of wheat, or of some one of the others,
translations.web: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

translations.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
translations.ylt: and God doth give to it a body according as He willed, and to each of the seeds its proper body.
translations.web: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

translations.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
translations.ylt: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, and another flesh of beasts, and another of fishes, and another of birds;
translations.web: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

translations.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
translations.ylt: and there are heavenly bodies, and earthly bodies; but one is the glory of the heavenly, and another that of the earthly;
translations.web: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

translations.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
translations.ylt: one glory of sun, and another glory of moon, and another glory of stars, for star from star doth differ in glory.
translations.web: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

translations.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
translations.ylt: So also is the rising again of the dead: it is sown in corruption, it is raised in incorruption;
translations.web: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

translations.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
translations.ylt: it is sown in dishonour, it is raised in glory; it is sown in weakness, it is raised in power;
translations.web: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

translations.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
translations.ylt: it is sown a natural body, it is raised a spiritual body; there is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body;
translations.web: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

translations.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
translations.ylt: so also it hath been written, `The first man Adam became a living creature,' the last Adam is for a life-giving spirit,
translations.web: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

translations.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
translations.ylt: but that which is spiritual is not first, but that which was natural, afterwards that which is spiritual.
translations.web: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

translations.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
translations.ylt: The first man is out of the earth, earthy; the second man is the Lord out of heaven;
translations.web: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

translations.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
translations.ylt: as is the earthy, such are also the earthy; and as is the heavenly, such are also the heavenly;
translations.web: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

translations.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
translations.ylt: and, according as we did bear the image of the earthy, we shall bear also the image of the heavenly.
translations.web: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

translations.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
translations.ylt: And this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood the reign of God is not able to inherit, nor doth the corruption inherit the incorruption;
translations.web: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

translations.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
