translations.ylt: lo, I tell you a secret; we indeed shall not all sleep, and we all shall be changed;
translations.web: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

translations.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
translations.ylt: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, in the last trumpet, for it shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we--we shall be changed:
translations.web: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

translations.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
translations.ylt: for it behoveth this corruptible to put on incorruption, and this mortal to put on immortality;
translations.web: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

translations.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
translations.ylt: and when this corruptible may have put on incorruption, and this mortal may have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the word that hath been written, `The Death was swallowed up--to victory;
translations.web: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

translations.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
translations.ylt: where, O Death, thy sting? where, O Hades, thy victory?'
translations.web: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

translations.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
translations.ylt: and the sting of the death is the sin, and the power of the sin the law;
translations.web: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

translations.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
translations.ylt: and to God--thanks, to Him who is giving us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ;
translations.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

translations.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
translations.ylt: so that, my brethren beloved, become ye stedfast, unmovable, abounding in the work of the Lord at all times, knowing that your labour is not vain in the Lord.
translations.web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

translations.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
translations.ylt: And concerning the collection that is for the saints, as I directed to the assemblies of Galatia, so also ye--do ye;
translations.web: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

translations.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
translations.ylt: on every first day of the week, let each one of you lay by him, treasuring up whatever he may have prospered, that when I may come then collections may not be made;
translations.web: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

translations.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
translations.ylt: and whenever I may come, whomsoever ye may approve, through letters, these I will send to carry your favour to Jerusalem;
translations.web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

translations.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
translations.ylt: and if it be meet for me also to go, with me they shall go.
translations.web: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

translations.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
translations.ylt: And I will come unto you, when I pass through Macedonia--for Macedonia I do pass through--
translations.web: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

translations.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
translations.ylt: and with you, it may be, I will abide, or even winter, that ye may send me forward whithersoever I go,
translations.web: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

translations.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
translations.ylt: for I do not wish to see you now in the passing, but I hope to remain a certain time with you, if the Lord may permit;
translations.web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

translations.kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
translations.ylt: and I will remain in Ephesus till the Pentecost,
translations.web: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

translations.kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
translations.ylt: for a door to me hath been opened--great and effectual--and withstanders are many.
translations.web: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

translations.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do.
translations.ylt: And if Timotheus may come, see that he may become without fear with you, for the work of the Lord he doth work, even as I,
translations.web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

translations.kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
translations.ylt: no one, then, may despise him; and send ye him forward in peace, that he may come to me, for I expect him with the brethren;
translations.web: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

translations.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
translations.ylt: and concerning Apollos our brother, much I did entreat him that he may come unto you with the brethren, and it was not at all his will that he may come now, and he will come when he may find convenient.
translations.web: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

translations.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
translations.ylt: Watch ye, stand in the faith; be men, be strong;
translations.web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

translations.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
translations.ylt: let all your things be done in love.
translations.web: Let all that you do be done in love.

translations.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
translations.ylt: And I entreat you, brethren, ye have known the household of Stephanas, that it is the first-fruit of Achaia, and to the ministration to the saints they did set themselves--
translations.web: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

translations.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us, and laboureth.
translations.ylt: that ye also be subject to such, and to every one who is working with us and labouring;
translations.web: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

translations.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
translations.ylt: and I rejoice over the presence of Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, because the lack of you did these fill up;
translations.web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

translations.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
translations.ylt: for they did refresh my spirit and yours; acknowledge ye, therefore, those who are such.
translations.web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

translations.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
translations.ylt: Salute you do the assemblies of Asia; salute you much in the Lord do Aquilas and Priscilla, with the assembly in their house;
translations.web: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

translations.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
translations.ylt: salute you do all the brethren; salute ye one another in an holy kiss.
translations.web: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

translations.kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
translations.ylt: The salutation of me Paul with my hand;
translations.web: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

translations.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maran-atha.
translations.ylt: if any one doth not love the Lord Jesus Christ--let him be anathema! The Lord hath come!
translations.web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

translations.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
translations.ylt: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ is with you;
translations.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

translations.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen. The first epistle to the Corinthians was written from Philippi by Stephanas, and Fortunatus, and Achaicus, and Timotheus.
translations.ylt: my love is with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
translations.web: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
